messages:
Sam: Dropped a prototype for a 'slab legend' 555 a compact control that sits inside the chart slab (left gutter) and shows tiny swatches + two-line summary. Goal: reduce vertical chrome on dashboards.
Hannah: cool. first impression: saves space but we need strong affordances for touch hit targets. currently the toggle area is only 20px.
Leo: agree on hit targets. For touch expand targets to 44px but keep visual density via negative margin hitboxes. Also add long-press to open full series menu on mobile.
Uma: Accessibility: slab legend should expose role="list" with each series role="listitem" and a button for controls. Tab order must land on series buttons. When collapsed, the slab has aria-label 'Series controls: 3 visible, 2 hidden'.
Sam: UX nit: the slab shows a small unit pill (auto) but ops asked for per-chart anchoring. Propose pill toggles: Auto | Anchor (keep base unit) | Raw. Hover shows formula.
Hannah: microcopy for pill tooltip: 'Auto: scale units. Anchor: keep base unit (e.g., per-s). Raw: no suffix.' Keep under 60 chars.
Leo: smoothing: product asked for an 'investigate friendly' mode that preserves outliers. I sketched an option 'robust' that uses biweight midvariance smoothing (robust to spikes) vs 'smooth' (SMA) vs 'fast' (EMA). Thoughts on naming?
Uma: prefer plain language: Off | Fast | Smooth | Preserve-peaks. Under the hood we can map preserve-peaks -> biweight. Show algorithm details on hover. Also auto-disable preserve-peaks if points < 15.
Sam: Outlier handling: new idea 555 sentinel markers instead of clipping chevrons. Use a thin caret ▲ with subtle halo and a small count badge if many clipped. Clicking caret expands inline or zooms to point. Default policy: clip at 99.7th percentile.
Hannah: keep tooltip copy short: 'Value clipped at display max. Press Enter to view raw.' For keyboard, focusable caret must have aria-label 'Clipped value at 2026-02-28T14:03:00: raw 12345'.
Leo: CSV/Export: include columns: timestamp, displayed_value, raw_value, clipped_flag, clip_reason. Also add a JSON metadata header row with chart state: {"units":"anchor","smoothing":"preserve-peaks","clip_pct":"99.7"}. Use a single JSON string cell to avoid nested CSV.
Uma: live region rules: when clipping toggles or when user expands a clipped point announce '3 points clipped; expanding shows raw values' but debounce announcements to 800ms so SR users don't get spammed.
Sam: URL sync: encode slab-state as q param slab=seriesA:show,smoothing:preserve-peaks,clip:99.7 so team links preserve view. Persist user defaults per-dashboard for non-URL overrides.
Hannah: performance: rendering many slab legends (large table of charts) is costly. Use virtualized DOM and only render full interactive slab for charts in viewport; render a lightweight placeholder otherwise. Defer smoothing computation with requestIdleCallback.
Leo: Telemetry: can we log how often users expand clipped points vs disable clipping? helps set sane defaults.
TelemetryBot: event hooks added: chart.clip.expand.count, chart.clip.toggle.count, chart.smoothing.mode.selected, slab.legend.interaction.method = {mouse, touch, keyboard}. All aggregated daily.
Uma: keyboard shortcuts: G to focus slab, I to isolate focused series, Enter toggles visibility, / toggles units pill (auto/anchor/raw). Document in keyboard help overlay. Announce changes via aria-live but keep terse.
Sam: tiny visual detail: when preserve-peaks is active show a small 'P' badge next to series name and hover to show 'Preserve peaks (biweight)'. For small widths collapse to one-letter badge.
Hannah: mobile: long-press opens contextual menu with 'Show raw, Zoom to point, Export series'. Must be operable via keyboard too.
Leo: implementation note: backend will return clipped_count and a clipped_sample array (up to 5 points) to avoid full payloads. Frontend requests clip_pct param and backend computes percentiles.
Uma: ok action items: Sam wire slab markup + pill + sentinel marker; Hannah handle touch hit-targets + microcopy; Leo draft export header + telemetry; I'll write a11y spec and live region rules. Review next Wednesday.
Sam: thanks all 44d Prototype pushed to staging: https://staging.redwood.com/visuals/slab-legend-2465 (snapshot ux-2465).
